planned_scope: Article's reported fourth-down risk-taking models estimated on NFL play-by-play data for 2000-2005 regular seasons, reconstructed from independently acquired nflverse public data. Exact model list fixed after reader reconciliation.

eligibility.public_source: eligible: nflverse play-by-play and schedules (CC-BY-4.0) cover all six seasons; two 2000 games lack play-by-play rows (registry/source_registry.json)

model_configuration: config/roles.json; actual launch records under sealed/memorization/*/ and readers/*/run1/

compute_budget.reader_runs: one initial run per reader; at most one written clarification round
compute_budget.implementations: three (A, B, C); at most 3 checker rounds per implementation
compute_budget.specifications: the frozen finite grid, fitted in full; no cap on grid size beyond what reconciliation sources
compute_budget.influence_diagnostics: registered before fitting (deletion unit and scope fixed from study design)

environment_notes: The venv Python cannot import ssl (missing Homebrew openssl@3 dylib), so all HTTPS was done with curl.
The acquisition role installed pyarrow 26.0.0 into the venv from a sha256-verified wheel (--no-index), and the R package nanoparquet 0.5.2 into /opt/homebrew/lib/R/4.6/site-library.
data/raw/download_log.tsv could not be made read-only (permission refusal); all raw data files are read-only.
